# HELP llm_d_coordinator_force_stream_total [ALPHA] Total number of force-stream candidate requests by model and outcome: forced (reassembled from a streamed upstream into one reply and written to the client), fallback_budget (budget full), fallback_unbounded (the reply estimate exceeds the per-request cap: a declared token limit too large for it, or an n whose per-choice overhead alone exceeds it), fallback_unsupported (declined before any upstream call: the request declares a field the reassembler drops, the engine would not serve it as a stream, or the kv-sglang connector, whose decode server cannot recompute a prompt on fallback), fallback_lossy_frame (a streamed frame carried a field the reassembler drops, such as reasoning from a server-side parser, so the request is re-sent after one upstream attempt; with a one-shot KV handoff the decode pod recomputes the prompt), fallback_oversize (Responses completed frame larger than the reservation plus the request body), fallback_unreadable (upstream 200 but a stream it could not parse), error_ceiling (buffered reply exceeded its reserved budget, usually a short byte estimate), error_upstream (upstream 4xx/5xx, or an error frame streamed after the 200, forwarded to the client), or error_transport (no upstream response). The fallback outcomes and error_ceiling take the non-forced pass-through; when the forced attempt already consumed a one-shot KV block handoff, the pass-through drops it and decode recomputes the prompt; error_upstream and error_transport are also classified generically by step_errors_total.
# TYPE llm_d_coordinator_force_stream_total counter
llm_d_coordinator_force_stream_total{model_name="meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",result="forced"} 5
